source: crea un mundo abierto donde ay muchos animales y tú eres una hormiga

image_prompt.text: Burrows and hollows at ground level - the ant nest the player returns to
A distinct natural structure visible across the world so a tiny player can navigate by sight
A central gathering area in the natural world where players congregate
many animals of different kinds inhabiting the world around the player

layout_placement.text: placement for the many animals populating the world

notes: The prompt is in Spanish: an open world with many animals where you are an ant.

The player being an ant is the load-bearing fact and it has no home in the handoff. Everything in the world has to be built at insect scale, which changes every dimension in the build, and neither the shape nor the scale band can say so.
No option covers a population of ambient animals; the genre has dens and landmarks but no creature placement.

open_questions.ask: At ant scale, how big is the world meant to feel - one garden bed that reads as vast, or a genuinely large area?
No theme was stated - should this be a lush stylized garden, or a realistic forest floor?
What does the ant do - build a colony, forage, survive the other animals, or just explore?

coverage_missing.ask: What is the ant trying to do?

answers.ask: At ant scale, how big is the world meant to feel - one garden bed that reads as vast, or a genuinely large area?
answers.answer: Un solo jardín debe sentirse enorme desde la escala de una hormiga; mantén el mapa compacto pero lleno de zonas para explorar.

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should this be a lush stylized garden, or a realistic forest floor?
answers.answer: Un jardín exuberante y estilizado, con plantas grandes, tierra, piedras y muchos animales visibles.

answers.ask: What does the ant do - build a colony, forage, survive the other animals, or just explore?
answers.answer: La hormiga debe explorar y recolectar comida para llevarla a su colonia; los demás animales hacen que el entorno se sienta vivo.
